content.title: Reach the frozen-user banking overview with transfers unavailable
content.intent: Prove that frozen_user reaches any permitted authenticated banking overview state while transfer functionality is unavailable, disabled, or rejected through normal UI paths.
content.technique_notes: Applied equivalence partitioning to the documented persona fixture frozen_user because persona changes the outcome; applied auth/permission because the promise is post-login and role/state gated; applied negative/error because the key behavior is blocked transfer access. Risk gate implied strength=3 because money and auth apply, but no combinatorial input matrix was needed because this path is defined by a single persona class.
